question: Do four-week changes in REAL Treasury yields, a historically genuine broad USD index and yield-curve spread improve BTC-only and strict BTC+Fed+NFCI+ANFCI up/down risk selection on original 2012-2025 weekly macro/BTC cohort?

sample.base: Exactly 684 same original v8.17.1 historical eligible Sunday dates. Existing BTC outcomes and macro flags unchanged; no new target optimization.
sample.newSources: All 684 Sunday as-of DFII10. T10Y2Y as-of from 2014-02-02; earlier 2012–Jan2014 derive from exact Sunday PIT DGS10 minus PIT DGS2, only when both are released and valid. USD DTWEXB (goods only) from 2014-03-23 through 2019-02-03, then DTWEXBGS (goods & services) from 2019-02-10, with no 4w difference spanning the regime change.
sample.unavailable: 2012–early 2014 dollar indicator UNKNOWN. No future reconstructed DTWEXBGS before first 2019-02-04 publication; event dates and source version guard first.
sample.analyticCohort: Common triple factor dates only when all three real yield, correct USD index and slope valid; also real yield all-dates and early pre2014 two-factor separate groups. Any FRED missing => UNKNOWN, never false.

sources.FRED: https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations with realtime_start and realtime_end each exact Sunday, latest observation 2..10 days before Sunday, 4w comparator 25..35 calendar days before most recent observation; min3 points and numeric.
sources.vintage: Save exact raw as-of JSON response with per-request SHA, aggregate JSONL archive and manifest R2 readback; failed HTTP429 retry serial and do not interpret as economic missing.
sources.dollarSemantics: Older DTWEXB is goods-only index Jan1997=100, modern DTWEXBGS is goods+services Jan2006=100. Never combine index levels across 2019 seam; within-series four-week percentage change signs only.

preregisteredIndicators.R: DFII10 latest minus 4w old >0, real US long interest rate tightening hypothesis
preregisteredIndicators.D: US dollar 4w relative change >0 within same ORIGINAL asof vintage and same series, stronger dollar hypothesis
preregisteredIndicators.C: 10y–2y Treasury spread 4w change <0, flattening hypothesis; inverted level<0 separately sensitivity
preregisteredIndicators.RECOVERY2: real yields easing AND broad dollar weakening
preregisteredIndicators.BULL_CLEAN: v8.17.1 all BTC+Fed+NFCI+ANFCI favorable AND neither R nor D tightening
preregisteredIndicators.BULL_WITH_STRESS: v8.17.1 all four favorable AND (R OR D) tightening
preregisteredIndicators.BTC_CLEAN: v8.17.1 BTC trend up AND neither R nor D tightening
preregisteredIndicators.BTC_STRESS: v8.17.1 BTC trend up AND (R OR D) tightening
preregisteredIndicators.NEG_ADD_STRESS: v8.17.1 adverse no-trend/no-Fed/no-Chicago AND (R OR D) tightening

outcomes: Exactly v8.17.1 frozen UP13 (+20% peak within 13 weeks), UP26 (+50% within 26w), UP52 (+100% within 52w), DOWN13 <=-20%, DOWN26 <=-35%, DOWN52 <=-50% against signal-date BTC daily close, POSITIVE13/26/52. No redefining events or threshold.

metrics.sameCohort: All matched samples SAME calendar dates for conditional vs original BTC-only and strict all-four. Report base and success count TP/FP/FN/TN precision recall, median close return, adverse rate 13/26/52, subperiod.
metrics.compare: BTC-CLEAN vs BTC-STRESS vs base BTC; STRICT_ALL clean vs STRICT_ALL stress vs strict all; NEG_ADD_STRESS vs NEG_ALL and full sample.
metrics.episode: For each indicator first warning and suppress next 13 full Sundays (14-week between alerts), 26w supplementary. Different selected dates not paired test.
metrics.warnings: Small late epochs or zero sample invalidates conclusion; no p-values, no OOS, all eras previously inspected; benchmark risk increase only if robust in historical episodes.
metrics.missing: Missing source and first-published data are unknown not missing economic signal. Two vintage indexes 2019 seam treated as different factor definitions even if direction signs merged.

noModify: Research-only, no changes Spot Futures NAV capital reserve PnL MASTER Detector risk limits or trades.
